title: Lighter Butter Chicken
desc: Butter chicken made with Greek yoghurt instead of cream. Makes two nights' worth, or dinner plus lunch.

portions.J: A quarter of the curry (about 1.5 cups), a cup of cooked rice
portions.P: About 1 cup of curry, 2/3 cup cooked rice

ingredients.name: Greek yoghurt (100 g to marinate, 170 g for the sauce)
fresh coriander, to serve
ingredients.food: fresh herbs (dill, mint, parsley or chives)

steps.title: Marinate the chicken
steps.text: Mix the chicken with 100 g of the yoghurt, 1 tsp garam masala, the paprika and a pinch of salt. Leave 20 minutes, or overnight.

steps.title: Rice on
steps.text: Rinse and cook the rice. Brown rice takes about 30 minutes.

steps.title: Sear the chicken
steps.text: Hot non-stick pan, a little spray oil if needed. Sear the chicken in batches until browned on the outside (it finishes in the sauce). Set aside.

steps.title: Build the sauce
steps.text: Lower the heat. Melt the butter, cook the onion until soft, then the garlic, ginger, cumin and remaining garam masala for a minute. Stir in the tomato paste, then the passata.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Return the chicken and simmer gently until cooked through and the sauce thickens.

steps.title: Finish with yoghurt
steps.text: Take it off the heat and let it cool for a minute, then stir in the remaining yoghurt (off the heat stops it splitting). Season and top with coriander.

notes: Leftovers keep 3 days or freeze well. Reheat gently and don't boil it, or the yoghurt splits.
